about.text: Casein paint, occasionally marketed as milk paint, derived from casein, is a fast-drying, water-soluble medium used by artists. It is a paint bound with casein. It can be made from milk and lime, generally with pigment added for color.

how.text: Made-up paint is mixed from dried casein powder, which an alkali has to dissolve before it binds. Which alkali decides how long the paint keeps and which pigments survive it. At home the same job is done with fresh strained curd.
